text:
andrew: Kicking off crescendo-style rollout for release v2.3.1. Plan: US -> EU -> APAC. Hold 15m at each slice, ramp steps 25% -> 60% -> 100%. tagging @sre-oncall @nina

deploy-bot: Rollout started: release=v2.3.1 commit=sha-def456 profile=crescendo slice=us canary=3 probes=health,smoke

nina: Capacity read: US GPU pool ~65% used (burst headroom ~22%), EU ~50%, APAC ~30%. US shows ~90 free inference slots.

rex: Heads-up: model uses 6144 ctx; we've seen cold-start mem spike ~2.1GB on first requests. Recommend prewarm.

sre-oncall: Suggested triggers: p99>550ms for 4m OR error rate>0.8% for 3m OR node GPU util>92% for 4m -> escalate/rollback.

zoe: Recommend EU fallback pinned to v2.3.1-ramtrim to avoid mem spike; ML thumbs pending but ramtrim OK for convo flows.

vikas: Rollback rules draft: immediate rollback if error rate>1% sustained 3m; staged scaleback if p99>2x baseline for 10m; abort if GPU util>95% on >=2 nodes for 2m.

andrew: Add auto-fallback: if canary 500s>0.4% in first 12m, rollback to v2.2.10. Also auto-pin EU->ramtrim if EU mem >80%.

deploy-bot: Canary logs: [00:01] canary-a ok; [00:03] warn retry=1 route=us latency=135ms; [00:05] canary-b ok; [00:09] smoke pass=98/100

nina: Smoke 120rps for 3m -> 0.18% 500s, p95 +15ms. Okay to move to 25% after warmup.

rex: Prewarm command: `rictl warm --model v2.3.1 --prefix popular-prompts --region us --concurrency 4` (est 4m). Running now.

sre-oncall: Note: EU network window scheduled 01:00-01:20 UTC. If it holds, swap APAC/EU order.

andrew: Swap plan accepted if maintenance holds. Starting traffic to US at 12%. Holdpoint at T+15m.

deploy-bot: Traffic update: us=12% eu=0% apac=0% state=running next_holdpoint=T+15m

vikas: Release notes TODO: ramtrim fallback, prewarm step, canary thresholds, crescendo pacing.

zoe: ML thumbs: ramtrim passes regression-chat subset; watch verbose token diffs.

andrew: If holdpoint clear, sequence 25% -> 60% -> 100% at +15m increments. Any trigger -> rollback to v2.2.10 and open incident channel.

rex: Prewarm complete, cold-starts reduced. Link: https://cw.example/prewarm/3690012345

sre-oncall: Dashboards: https://dash.example/s/v2-3-1-us (p95 stable, p99 +20ms). No GPU alarms.

nina: Proceeding to 25%.

deploy-bot: Traffic update: us=25% eu=0% apac=0% state=running next_holdpoint=T+30m

andrew: Thanks team. Keep posting live signals here. Ping if we need to reorder regions or abort. :white_check_mark:
